articles.title: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’
articles.highlight: 香港两名组织纪念1989年天安门事件的年度守夜活动的人士，被判‘煽动颠覆国家政权罪’成立。
articles.summary: 文章报道，香港社运人士李卓人和邹幸彤因组织纪念1989年天安门事件的年度守夜活动，被裁定‘煽动颠覆国家政权罪’成立，最高可判监禁10年。英国外交部批评香港国安法被用于定罪。此案是香港国安法2020年实施以来最受关注的案件之一，凸显相关法律对集会纪念活动的限制及国际争议。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：在香港国安法框架下，组织纪念活动即可能被认定为‘煽动颠覆’，法律风险极高；西方批评不太可能改变司法走向。
articles.sourceExcerpt: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date.

articles.title: The Resilience of Uncertainty: How to Hold the Universe in You
articles.highlight: 我们渴望确定性，却一再发现它是海市蜃楼；对生活的热爱植根于不确定性的勇气——因为确定性不容惊喜。
articles.summary: 文章借托芙·扬松的话与丽莎·罗森伯格的思考，指出生活的仁慈在于我们可以改变、可以重新选择，而预测的陷阱恰恰是人的不可预测。它提醒我们，确定感是幻象，接纳不确定性才能保有惊喜与韧性。值得阅读是因为它把存在主义的哲思融入日常生命经验，给人温和的勇气。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：不要用确定性思维框定人生，真正的韧性来自与未知共处。
articles.sourceExcerpt: The great mercy of life is that we can change, we can reroute, we can surprise ourselves. The great pitfall of prediction is that, mercifully, we are unpredictable. — “All things are so very uncertain, and that’s exactly what makes me feel reassured,” Tove Jansson wrote in one of our civilization’s great works of philosophy disguised as a children’s book.

articles.title: What Garmin's 'Recovery Time' Estimate Actually Means
articles.highlight: 这个38小时只是基于数据的估算，实际恢复速度因人而异，别把它当成精确倒计时。
articles.summary: 这篇文章解释了Garmin设备中的“恢复时间”是如何根据心率、睡眠和训练负荷等数据估算出来的，并指出它并非精确的生理指标。它提醒用户应结合自身感受来调整训练计划，而不是机械地等待倒计时归零。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键要点：恢复时间是一个有用的参考工具，但不应被当作绝对标准，倾听身体的感觉更重要。

zh.title: OpenBot：开源AI同事，每个拥有独立电脑环境
zh.highlight: 每个AI同事都有自己的电脑：浏览器、文件和工具，每个动作都在发生前决定并在事后记录。
zh.summary: OpenBot是一个开源项目，目标是让AI代理拥有独立的浏览器、文件和工具，并支持任何AG-UI代理。它的核心设计强调每个动作先决定后执行并完整记录，代表AI从聊天助手向可执行任务代理演进的趋势。本文值得关注是因为它展示了这种“AI同事”的实现方式及开源生态的推进。
zh.failureAnalysis: 这类“AI同事”若要在真实任务中可靠执行，依赖LLM的决策准确性，一旦出错可能造成不可逆后果，需要严格审批机制。维护隔离的浏览器与工具环境成本高，且数据安全和治理要求复杂。当前仍需解决用户信任和商业化落地问题，否则容易停留在演示阶段。

en.highlight: Each AI coworker gets its own computer: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after.
en.summary: OpenBot is an open-source project that gives AI agents their own browser, files and tools, and supports any AG-UI agent. Its core design emphasizes that every action is decided first, executed, and fully recorded. This matters because it represents a shift from chat assistants to task-executing agents in an open-source ecosystem.
en.failureAnalysis: This kind of 'AI coworker' requires reliable LLM decision-making; a wrong action may cause irreversible consequences and needs strict human approval. Running isolated browser and tool environments is costly, and data security/governance is complex, so it may stay at the demo stage without clear trust and monetization.
en.title: OpenBot: Open-Source AI Coworkers, Each with Their Own Computer
